# GitHub Copilot instructions

Always read and follow
[`CODING_GUIDELINES.md`](../CODING_GUIDELINES.md) before generating, reviewing,
or editing code. It is the canonical repository standard and applies to source,
tests, scripts, documentation, and configuration.

Also follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), including its requirement to consult
the installed documentation in `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` before changing
Next.js behavior. Do not suggest completion until the repository quality gates
defined by those files pass.
